# canonical_graphics — lesson index

This directory is a snapshot of a real Field document: the `afield.four` graphics curriculum, worked lesson by lesson against the live renderer. Every file is named by box uid, so this index exists to make the corpus reachable by name and by API. The prose walkthrough, with captured native-window images, is [afield.four Graphics](../../afield_four_graphics.md).

Boxes here are read-only reference. To *run* one, copy its Kotlin and shader properties into a box of your own beneath a renderer parent — see the graphics topology rule in `dev_docs/agents/transcripts/README.md`.

## The renderer parent

`window` — `611072da-1af6-4d2d-85bf-07a9ba191aca_code_.kt`. Opens the `Window`, builds the `Renderer` and pumps the frame loop. Every lesson below runs as its child, directly or through another lesson.
